prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but “best” depends on your exact location, the type of job (simple repair vs. major replacement), and what matters most to you (price, speed, warranty, brand experience). If you give your ZIP code or neighborhood I’ll pull 3–5 highly rated local options and short notes about each.

Meanwhile, here are quick guidelines and what to expect:

What to look for in a Houston HVAC company
- Valid Texas HVAC contractor license (TACLA number) and liability insurance.
- NATE-certified technicians and EPA 608 certification for refrigerant work.
- Transparent, written estimates and a clear diagnostic fee policy.
- Good local reviews (Google, Yelp, Angi) and a solid BBB rating.
- Clear warranty on parts and labor and an emergency / after-hours option if you need it fast.
- Experience with your system brand (if it’s a specialty make/model).
- Membership in trade groups (ACCA, local HVAC associations) is a plus.

Typical costs (Houston, ballpark)
- Diagnostic call: $75–$150 (may be waived if you proceed with repair).
- Minor repairs (capacitor, contactor, thermostat): $100–$400.
- Major repairs (compressor, condenser): $800–$2,500+.
- If unit is old and costly to repair, replacement may be more cost-effective.

Red flags to avoid
- High-pressure sales to replace now without diagnosing.
- No written estimate or vague scope of work.
- Technician won’t show license/insurance or provide references.
- Very low price with no clear warranty.

If you want, tell me your ZIP code and whether this is residential or commercial and I’ll list the top-rated local HVAC companies for AC repair (with short pros/cons and review links).
